item.title: Daily Minute — September 16, 2026
item.description: Most curious of all is the concept of the self which the ego fosters in the special relationship. This “self ” seeks the relationship to make itself complete. Yet when it FINDS the special relationship in which it thinks it can accomplish this, it gives itself AWAY, and tries to “trade” itself for the self of another.
